CURRENT REPOSITORY MAP + PROPOSED POLICY | November 10, 2026 | Blue: SQL facts and views Gray: application consumers Orange: change Green: settlement

Scope: checked-in SQL, generated IaC views, materialization procedures and named application readers. Live project-wide view inventory was denied; ad hoc external BI views are not enumerated. Arrows show data dependencies; scheduler calls are labelled separately.
Read left to right. Dataset prefix is boost_performance unless billing is explicitly shown. Tables and procedures are named in the boxes.

Materialization control: rebuild_revenue_attributed -> fact partition replacement -> CALL billing.rebuild_boost_priced_deltas -> pricing snapshot -> revenue_rebuild_receipt. Billing readiness waits for receipts, not table modification time.
A view change can propagate through these branches without touching Meta or Postgres creative identity.

Interpretation for discussion: all eligible BRAND-FUNDED ads, not publisher self-funded ads or all basket products. No policy is activated by this diagram.

activation dates. Real creator remains nullable.
Real creator: private / public product rates. No creator: public
product / eligible website backup. Usage remains separate.

retained performance fee. Never use unresolved creator_ref.

Fee scope and activation | public / private / website rates | 0% behavior | additional usage vs combined price | network commission offsets | retained
Example with proposed 10% performance fee + 7% usage
Eligible $100 brand-owned sale -> $10 performance fee + $7 usage. Real partnership: creator payable under normal split. Brand-owned ad: $10 retained by
Wayward. Affiliate network commission remains separate.

Unaffected operational paths: Meta identity, creator approval, comment replies, promo consent, creator logos / voice, discovery and creative access. Their Postgres partnership field remains unchanged.
